claims.statement: Nasdaq accepted the AWC April7 2015. Scout consented without admitting or denying findings, before hearing and without adjudication, to findings and a censure plus USD3000000 fine.
The AWC investigative period is Jan1 2010 through Mar16 2012, but its applicable period is Nov9 2011 through Mar16 2012 because it covers the period of Scout Nasdaq membership.
AWC findings address Regulation SHO Rule204 and Nasdaq Rules2110 and3010, including inadequate supervisory procedures.
A FINRA May2016 bulletin identifies Wedbush as Scout clearing firm and reports a separate USD675000 joint FINRA/Nasdaq fine against Wedbush; it separately recounts Scout USD3million sanction.
claims.qualification: Do not add Wedbush penalty to Scout penalties or attribute it personally to Bleich; bulletin publication month is not settlement date.
